Markus —

I reviewed the traces. Root cause looks like an eviction/amplification pattern in the KV layer when a subset of hot prefixes generated rapid writes, which cascaded into higher CPU on the serving fleet and additional tokenization retries. Given the time sensitivity, I recommend we proceed with the geo swap to us-west-1. Operational notes:
- We can flip routing in ~8-12 minutes once we push the routing policy change.
- We'll apply prefix-cache-bypass for the HarvestCare customer ID during the cutover to reduce repeated KVCACHE misses.
- Expect transient 1xx-3xx/request redirects during DNS / routing propagation; the service should be stable within ~10 minutes after the swap begins if the canary looks good.
- I will open a short-lived override on the autoscaler for harvestcare to prevent aggressive spin-ups that could amplify the condition.

I'll start the routing PR now and coordinate with infra on the canary thresholds. Priyom — please prepare the customer note and confirm the credit band we typically offer for this severity; Markus / Vanessa, will you lead the exec comms?

D.
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
